description: Packable source packages intentionally omitted from the user-facing package inventory.

packages.Microsoft.Orleans.Analyzers: Build-time analyzer implementation delivered transitively by Microsoft.Orleans.Sdk, not a direct application dependency.
packages.Microsoft.Orleans.CodeGenerator: Build-time source-generator implementation delivered transitively by Microsoft.Orleans.Sdk, not a direct application dependency.
packages.Microsoft.Orleans.Core: Low-level runtime dependency composed by the client and server metapackages; application authors should not select it as an entry point.
packages.Microsoft.Orleans.Core.Abstractions: Low-level contract assembly composed by Microsoft.Orleans.Sdk and the metapackages; direct use is reserved for narrow library scenarios.
packages.Microsoft.Orleans.DurableMessaging: The experimental package is not yet published to NuGet; add it to the user-facing inventory after its first publication.
packages.Microsoft.Orleans.Runtime: Low-level silo runtime implementation composed by Microsoft.Orleans.Server; application hosts should use the server metapackage.
packages.Microsoft.Orleans.Serialization: Low-level serializer runtime composed by Microsoft.Orleans.Sdk; applications select the SDK or a format integration package.
packages.Microsoft.Orleans.Serialization.Abstract: Low-level serializer contracts composed by Microsoft.Orleans.Sdk; direct use is intended for serializer integration authors.
